title: Pointwise etaleness is preserved and reflected by field extension
statement: Let k be a field, K/k a field extension, and f:X\to Y a morphism of k-schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], with base change f_K:X_K\to Y_K along \operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k [def-pc-base-change]. For every point x\in X and every point x_K\in X_K above x, f is etale at x (etale on an open neighbourhood of x [def-weil-etale-morphism]) if and only if f_K is etale at x_K.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma Tag 0C4Y (lemma-change-fields-flat: O_{X,x} -> O_{X_K,x_K} faithfully flat) with Descent, Lemma Tag 02VN (lemma-descending-property-etale) and Tag 036N (lemma-locally-finite-presentation-fppf-local-source); the tags 02H5/02H6 given before are unrelated (first order thickenings, infinitesimal lifting)
